pairs.registryProposal: workspace-ancestry-isolation says to capture the loaded set through a session-inspection command, a load hook, or a debug log. When isolation is done with a flag that turns off instruction files AND hooks together (here `--safe-mode`), the hook route is gone. The technique should say how to assert an empty loaded set in that case, for example a probe that plants a canary brief in an ancestor directory and checks that the agent ignores it.
